verdict.rationale: Linear's docs describe a 'Write with Agent' feature that reviews recent project changes and linked Slack messages to draft a status update automatically (linear-docs-19, linear-docs-38), directly matching the story for projects. Initiative-level updates aren't explicitly called out, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of quality or accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit initiative-level update drafting evidence, independent/hands-on corroboration of the feature's real-world quality.
